props.title: Optional supplementary hover/focus help.
props.variant: primary (default), secondary, ghost, danger or plain (unstyled, without shared appearance or focus treatment).
props.busy: Boolean; prevents activation and exposes aria-busy. Supply progress wording.

SituateButton.usage: Native click and form attributes/listeners are supported. Use one primary action per decision group. Ref exposes element and focus().

SituateIconButton.purpose: Compact action with an accessible label.

props.label: Required accessible action name.
props.title: Optional supplementary hover/focus help.
props.unavailableReason: Optional explanation for a disabled action.

SituateIconButton.usage: Native click listener. Ref exposes element and focus(). Never rely on an icon alone to name an action.

SituateIcon.purpose: Decorative icon from the host vocabulary.

props.name: Required host icon name, for example folder.

SituateIcon.usage: Pair with visible text or a named control; do not use as an accessible label.

SituateInput.purpose: Single-line text, search or numeric input.

props.modelValue: Optional string or number; use v-model for owned text.
props.modelModifiers: Optional {trim,lazy,number} booleans, supplied by v-model modifiers.

SituateInput.usage: Native input attributes/listeners including type, required and autocomplete. Bind Field controlAttrs. Ref exposes element, focus(), select(), setSelectionRange().

props.modelValue: Optional string or number; use v-model for owned text.
props.modelModifiers: Optional {trim,lazy,number} booleans, supplied by v-model modifiers.

SituateTextarea.usage: Native textarea attributes/listeners including rows and required. Bind Field controlAttrs. Ref exposes element, focus(), select(), setSelectionRange().

SituateCheckbox.usage: Supply a label with Field or a wrapping native label. Native checked/change ownership is also supported. Ref exposes element and focus().

SituateRadio.purpose: One choice within a mutually exclusive group.
SituateRadio.usage: Use a native fieldset/legend, shared name and a label per radio. Native attributes/listeners are supported. Ref exposes element and focus().

SituateSelect.purpose: Single-value choice with host listbox or mobile sheet.

props.value: Optional string/number with native change ownership.
props.name: Optional form field name.

events.input: Native Event targeting the hidden form select.
events.change: Native Event targeting the hidden form select.

slots.default: Native option and optgroup elements, not custom menu items.

SituateSelect.usage: Bind Field controlAttrs. focus() targets the visible combobox; .element is the hidden native select. Do not recreate its popup or keyboard behavior.

SituateSwitch.usage: Supply a label. Native checked/change ownership is also supported. Ref exposes element and focus().

SituateFilterChip.usage: Use for removing a filter, not switching a setting or navigating.

SituateField.purpose: Control label, help and validation association.

props.id: Optional stable control ID; otherwise generated.
props.label: Visible label.
props.error: Optional current validation error; takes precedence over warning.
props.warning: Optional nonblocking feedback; does not set aria-invalid.
props.reserveFeedback: Reserve two short feedback lines; default false. Long messages wrap and grow.
props.announce: Use a polite atomic feedback live region; default false. Disable when focusing an invalid control on submission.

slots.default: Scope: {id,describedBy,invalid,controlAttrs}. Bind v-bind="controlAttrs" to exactly one control.

SituateField.usage: Place instructions outside placeholders. Clearing error removes its description association. Use fieldset/legend for groups.

props.tone: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

SituateBadge.usage: Name the actual state in text; color alone is insufficient. No automatic live-region role.

props.tone: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

SituateNotice.usage: Caller supplies role=status or role=alert only when an announcement is appropriate. State known outcome and useful recovery without claiming rollback.

SituateEmptyState.purpose: Empty collection or no matching results.
SituateEmptyState.usage: Distinguish an empty source from filtered-out results and failed loading. Offer a relevant action rather than decorative filler.

SituatePanel.usage: Use when a surface groups content; avoid a separate card around every row. Supply your own semantic headings.

props.open: Optional boolean for caller-owned modal state; omit when using showModal()/close().

slots.actions: Optional actions in the shared dialog footer.

SituateDialog.usage: Ref exposes element, showModal(), close(returnValue?), focus(). Supply aria-labelledby, initial focus, a labeled close action and invoker focus restoration. Native close/cancel events are forwarded; update caller-owned open when they occur. There is no v-model contract.

SituateDialogActions.usage: Dialog's actions slot already provides this layout. Use the component directly only for a separate dialog action group.

props.open: Required boolean, owned by the caller.
props.label: Required accessible name.
props.anchor: Optional native HTMLElement or null; use a component ref's .element.
props.point: Optional viewport {x,y} instead of an anchor.
props.align: start or end; end by default.
props.maxHeight: Optional pixel height, bounded by available viewport space.

SituatePopover.usage: Ref exposes element and dismiss(). Surface placement handles viewport bounds and modal hosting. Arbitrary content does not gain menu keyboard navigation.

props.open: Required boolean, owned by the caller.
props.label: Required accessible name.
props.anchor: Optional native HTMLElement or null; use a component ref's .element.
props.point: Optional viewport {x,y} instead of an anchor.
props.align: start or end; end by default.
props.maxHeight: Optional pixel height, bounded by available viewport space.

SituateMenu.usage: Supply menuitem/menuitemradio/menuitemcheckbox controls with checked state and handlers. Shared menu owns keyboard navigation and dismissal; caller owns actions and open state.

SituateDisclosure.usage: Uses native details/summary. Ref exposes element and focus(). Do not use as a substitute for navigation tabs.

events.describe: Description ID or undefined; associate it with an external trigger when using anchor.

SituateTooltip.usage: The trigger still needs an accessible name. Button title and IconButton label/title already provide shared help; do not nest redundant tooltips.

props.label: Required accessible name.
props.value: Optional finite number; omit for indeterminate work.
props.estimate: Optional fraction for indeterminate visual fill only.

SituateProgress.usage: Keep visible status wording outside an aria-busy region. Never present an estimate as measured completion. Stop pending feedback on every terminal outcome.

SituateScrollbars.usage: Mounted once by the application; do not mount per plugin. Does not replace scrolling surfaces.

SituateResizeHandle.purpose: Caller-owned internal region resizing in pixels.
SituateResizeHandle.usage: Caller owns geometry and persistence. Ref exposes cancel(). Do not use to override host pane layout or create plugin-selected pane splits.
